name: Chigasaki Chiharu
source:
Birthplace: Kanagawa Prefecture
Special skills: Singing & MC
Hobby: Karaoke
Favorite Food: Curry

Member of Kanto's project 47's "Team Happy" who is ranked 5th between all of the project 47's idols. Chiharu got to the world of idols by winning in the late-night talent show "Yofukashi Himawari". An extremely optimistic and hardworking girl who has common sense and can be quite intuitive at times. Being an outgoing and honest character, Chiharu is known to perform acts such as shaking the hands of all fans and staff members during events and earnestly thanking her fans. Though highly skeptical of the D.o.D, Chiharu decides to participate in it to fulfill her dream of becoming the top idol.

[spoiler]Her real name is Sakura Honjou, the only daughter of the extremely wealthy Honjou family. However, when Sakura was 6 months old, she was kidnapped by Kouji Chigasaki. Her real father, Kei Honjou, rushed to the ransom delivery without even calling the police, but he died in a car accident halfway through and couldn't deliver the ransom money. Kouji Chigasaki heard the news about that and realized he would get no Honjou money in this state. It would be dangerous to try to return the baby, so he decided to raise her as his daughter instead.[/spoiler]
